articles.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
articles.snippet: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.

articles.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
articles.snippet: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips with Nvidia as ETF outflows reach day five
articles.snippet: Bitcoin slips 0.7% as Nvidia falls on reports its board may oust CEO Jensen Huang, while U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lose another $299.9 million.

articles.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
articles.snippet: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

articles.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
articles.snippet: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.
